tweets.title: We’ve also improved our mid-training recipe to improve the capabilities of these models and expand the context length. Llama 4 Scout supports 10M token length d
tweets.body: We’ve also improved our mid-training recipe to improve the capabilities of these models and expand the context length. Llama 4 Scout supports 10M token length during inference! https://t.co/WKwSWP9weU

tweets.title: Maverick has 128 experts and interleaves dense & sparse layers for inference efficiency. Maverick has been trained with distillation using logits from Behem
tweets.body: Maverick has 128 experts and interleaves dense & sparse layers for inference efficiency. Maverick has been trained with distillation using logits from Behemoth. Maverick is the best multimodal model in its class, beating GPT-4o & Gemini 2.0 Flash across several benchmarks. https://t.co/MtIzmK8lo8

tweets.title: The data team has made a lot of improvements to the data since Llama 3 and we’ve worked meticulously to build a datamix to ensure the highest model quality. Lla
tweets.body: The data team has made a lot of improvements to the data since Llama 3 and we’ve worked meticulously to build a datamix to ensure the highest model quality. Llama 4 Scout was trained on 40 trillion tokens of image and text data.

tweets.title: Llama 4 models have been trained jointly with text and images to be natively multimodal. Unlike our previous models, the text backbone is not frozen. We use a M
tweets.body: Llama 4 models have been trained jointly with text and images to be natively multimodal. Unlike our previous models, the text backbone is not frozen. We use a MetaCLIP style encoder to generate image embeddings.

tweets.title: Llama 4 models have been trained using FP8. We’ve been iterating on the FP8 recipe and have trained Behemoth (288B active parameter) model with FP8. The 288B mo
tweets.body: Llama 4 models have been trained using FP8. We’ve been iterating on the FP8 recipe and have trained Behemoth (288B active parameter) model with FP8. The 288B model was trained on 32K GPUs, we achieved 390 TFLOPs/GPU with FP8. Very proud of all the folks who made this possible!

tweets.title: Llama 4 models are trained with Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. The team improved the training efficiency of MoEs, working on training stability to ensur
tweets.body: Llama 4 models are trained with Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. The team improved the training efficiency of MoEs, working on training stability to ensure these models smoothly, and built datamixes to ensure that the models are not overfitting. https://t.co/wp18xxUnqc

tweets.body: @deliprao Actually the chinchilla paper helped the field significantly. Before that, the original scaling laws paper recommended scaling the model size at the same rate as the dataset size. Chinchilla showed the correct formulation of scaling laws.
